module: Flowgraph node "Set Input Actions" (once_instant, depends on core_input_actionFilter). Blocks or allows a list of input actions, as a scenario does. The list (self.list) is chosen in the properties (Empty/Scenario presets, search, categories). Pins: block (default true: blocks, otherwise allows), ignoreUnrestriced (ignores the node if "restrictScenarios" is disabled in the settings), input id (reuse an existing list) and output id (identifier of the list, to cancel it later).

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's own settings from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Adds the node's own settings to the `res` table when saving the graph.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the action list editor (presets, add by search or category, current list).

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the number of actions and renames the node to Block/Allow Input Actions if block is hard-coded.

drawSearchInput.desc: Draws the action search field and updates the results.

init.desc: Initializes the list with the Scenario preset and the search engine.

workOnce.desc: Registers the list in the flowgraph action module (registerList) if not already done, then calls blockActions(id) or allowActions(id).
